scope: Existing evidence review; no new GPU timing or replacement of b-g results.
cold_method: NCU gpu__time_duration.sum, cache-control all before every selected kernel, kernel replay one pass; fifth denoising step, three requests; multiplied by ten as estimate.
natural_method: warm steady-state, natural cache; no flush, no kernel replay, no DRAM-subtraction
natural_samples: 5 requests; average all 10 real denoising steps per request; 18 layers each
qualifications: Both are sums of GPU kernel durations, not an unprofiled RoPE end-to-end measurement.
Different profilers, clock state and execution conditions mean their ratio is not a cache-only effect.
Current d-e gain is conditional on the retained eager/unfused cold-kernel GPU baseline; it is not evidence against an optimized fused GPU RoPE.
Uniform memory timing assumption does not imply flushing caches between GPU RoPE kernels.
optimized_baseline_requirements: Equivalent Q/K shapes, layout, dtype and RoPE semantics; verify numerical agreement.
Fuse GPU RoPE and measure at the actual producer/consumer handoff boundary without artificial per-kernel cache flush.
Separate device time from end-to-end launch/synchronization time and account for real GPU/PIM handoff costs.
